title: Freedom Yield Metal — A-chain Anchor Receipt v1
description: Formal contract for /api/anchor-receipt.json. The receipt republishes the most recent Metal A-chain (PulseVM / XPRNetwork) inscription that anchors a Merkle DAG root committed by /api/identity.json and summarised by /api/cycles-history.json. The receipt is a content-addressed pointer: an evaluator may independently look up the receipt's tx_id on a public XPR explorer and assert memo == "fyid1:" + dag_root_hash. The receipt is regenerated each time a new inscription is broadcast (= cycle start, cycle end, or identity key rotation). Method discriminator: the anchor.method enum identifies whether the inscription is the Phase α minimal form (= eosio.token::transfer) or the Phase β dedicated form (= freedomyield::inscribe smart-contract action). Companion design: docs/MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md. Schema stability: additive-only within v1; breaking changes go to /api/anchor-receipt.schema.v2.json and the v1 URL stays reachable for at least 18 months.

dag_root_hash.description: The 64-hex SHA-256 DAG root being anchored. Equals identity.json.dag_root_hash and cycles-history.json.dag_root_hash for the same publication moment.

memo.description: The exact memo string carried by the on-chain inscription. MUST equal 'fyid1:' + dag_root_hash. The 'fyid1:' prefix (Freedom Yield identity, format version 1) lets future on-chain parsers distinguish our inscriptions and lets us migrate to 'fyid2:' without colliding with intervening unrelated memos.

chain.description: Metal Blockchain A-chain (= PulseVM / XPRNetwork). One of the four chains of the Primary Network.

network.description: xpr-mainnet for production receipts; xpr-testnet appears only in dry-run example data.

method.description: Discriminator for which on-chain mechanism was used. Phase α uses the minimum-cost eosio.token::transfer with the memo carrying the binding (action shape: account/name/from/to/quantity/memo/permission). Phase β uses a dedicated freedomyield::inscribe smart-contract action with a six-field typed payload (action shape: account/name/data/authorization). The if/then/else blocks in this schema dispatch inscribe_action.required on this discriminator so a single receipt schema cleanly covers both eras. See scripts/operator-local/contract/freedomyield-anchor.spec.md for the Phase β action specification.

explorer_url.description: Public XPRNetwork explorer URL pointing at the inscribing transaction. Independent verifier MUST be able to load this URL and read back the same tx_id, memo, action account, action name, and signer permission.

account.description: On-chain contract account that owns the action. For phase_alpha_token_transfer: 'eosio.token'. For phase_beta_sc_inscribe: 'freedomyield'.

name.description: Action name. For phase_alpha_token_transfer: 'transfer'. For phase_beta_sc_inscribe: 'inscribe'.

from.description: Phase α only. Source XPR account = 'freedomyield' (the operator-controlled account holding the anchor permission). Omitted in Phase β SC inscribe receipts (the freedomyield::inscribe action has no from/to semantics).

to.description: Phase α only. Destination XPR account. MUST NOT equal 'from' — the XPRNetwork eosio.token contract rejects self-transfer at the contract level ('cannot transfer to self', eosio.token.cpp L99). The destination is a separate sink account distinct from 'freedomyield'; the specific sink name is operator-chosen (see docs/MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md §6 and the Phase α design memo). Omitted in Phase β receipts.

quantity.description: Phase α only. XPR asset quantity in the standard EOSIO string form, e.g. '0.0001 XPR'. The minimum on-chain quantity allowed by the eosio.token contract for Phase α self-anchoring. Omitted in Phase β receipts.

memo.description: Phase α only. MUST equal the top-level memo field. Repeated here for direct visual cross-check against the explorer's view of the action. Omitted in Phase β receipts (the binding is in data.root_hash instead).

permission.description: Narrow child permission scoped via linkauth to inscribe-class actions only. Compromise of the anchor key cannot move tokens, change permissions, or deploy contracts; it can only re-broadcast an anchor with a different root, which an evaluator's chain-of-trust check would reject as soon as the operator publishes a contradicting signed identity.json.
Phase α: required (= the singular {actor, permission} signer). Phase β: optional (= a parallel `authorization` array is used instead, mirroring the Antelope/EOSIO action.authorization shape).

cycle_id.description: P-Chain cycle number this inscription pertains to. uint32_t at the contract level.

event_type.description: Antelope name-typed enum. Constrained by the contract via check() in the inscribe action body.

root_hash.description: 64-hex SHA-256. Equals the top-level dag_root_hash for this inscription.

prev_root.description: 64-hex. The most recently accepted root_hash, fetched from the contract's `roots` table at inscription time. For the first Phase β inscription (= genesis) this is 64 zero characters '0000...0000'; the contract enforces this via the genesis check.

leaf_hash.description: 64-hex. The specific leaf being asserted in this event (= the cycle-start leaf hash for cyclestart, the identity-history leaf hash for idrotate). The contract does NOT validate this hash against the root; off-chain verifiers do so.

payload.description: Optional structured metadata (JSON-encoded), UTF-8, up to 256 bytes (= contract-enforced, matches Phase α memo limit). MAY be empty string.

data.description: Phase β only. The structured action payload of freedomyield::inscribe. Six fields per scripts/operator-local/contract/freedomyield-anchor.spec.md §2.1. Omitted in Phase α receipts.

authorization.description: Phase β only. Antelope/EOSIO-style action.authorization. For phase_beta_sc_inscribe: authorization[0] = {actor: 'freedomyield', permission: 'anchor'}. Omitted in Phase α receipts (the singular `permission` field is used instead).

cycles_history_url.description: URL of /api/cycles-history.json — the DAG snapshot whose root this receipt anchors. The DAG snapshot in turn references the leaf source JSONL documents.

identity_url.description: URL of /api/identity.json — the signed manifest that carries the operator's commitment to this dag_root_hash via its additive dag_root_hash field. The receipt and the signed manifest cross-reference each other.

trigger_event.description: What caused this anchor to be broadcast. Informational; the on-chain inscription is the canonical commitment regardless.

trigger_reference.description: Optional structured pointer to the triggering on-chain or off-chain event (e.g., the cycle_n that started, the key_seq that rotated). Additive shape; consumers MAY ignore.
